notes.note: Reviewed the disposable Linux service fixture against workload-scoped PTY launch, terminal-session close and scope cleanup. The focused Ubuntu arm64 run passed all 19 cases, including close of a shell that ignores hangup, PID exit, the scope cleanup receipt and a separate SIGHUP flush. The suite still runs with real systemd and native PTY prerequisites.
